title: Assignment binding v1
description: The versioned binding of the full approved assignment to the admitted run (WP-23, E sections 2 and 10): a Field Case delegate does not carry the assignment identity alone. The request carries the approved assignment (AssignmentApproval: explicit domain_meaning and the five SOP 5.1 currency ceilings; adoptable_problem is NOT caller-suppliable — the frozen case supplies it, and instruction already travels on the delegate request). SEA-Forge composes the full Assignment (assignment.v1), binds it to the existing run and link under the existing case-lock serialization, and records it on the assignment row as `binding`. The trusted read joins case, episode, assignment, link and run; a legacy row without a recorded binding, or a partial append, fails closed.

trust.description: Retrieved context is labelled untrusted reference (AT-17).

domain_meaning.description: SOP 7.4: the domain meaning, explicit from the approval path. Never defaulted, never derived from the generic case budget or token ceiling.

budget.description: Exactly five entries, one per SOP 5.1 currency, each ceiling a number >= 0 or "unknown" (SOP 5.3: an unmeasured currency is unknown, never 0). Units are fixed per currency by assignment.v1.

AssignmentApproval.description: What a Field Case delegate request carries as `assignment`. The five currencies must each appear exactly once (ASSIGNMENT_BUDGET_INVALID semantics; the schema bounds the count, uniqueness is semantic).

version.description: The binding record version. A future shape change is a new version, never an in-place edit.

assignment.description: The full approved assignment as SEA-Forge composed it: instruction from the delegate request, adoptable_problem from the frozen reference's criteria.intention, domain_meaning and context_refs from the approval, budget ceilings from the approval. Its id fields repeat the row's assignment_id and must agree (assignment.v1 semantics).

link_id.description: The delegation link written before the run (delegation-link.v1). The binding, the link and the run join exactly.

run_id.description: The existing admitted run: the binding reuses it as reservation and correlation identity; no separate id is minted.

binding_digest.description: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 of {assignment_id, episode_ref, brief, budget, link_id, run_id} — the assignment.v1 Assignment members plus the two join ids.
